title: Convert a complete terminal mismatch law into Bell-recovery comparison
statement: For a policy with subnormalized terminal branches L_h of trace p_h, the ordinary state2-design mismatch obeys q=d/(d+1)(1-F_e(sum L_h)). Uniform full-law TV error eta and planning slack zeta give Bell-loss regret<=((d+1)/d)(2eta+zeta), with no division by rare history.
